The detail service returns `{ id, displayName, amountMinor }`; the form draft uses `{ displayName, amountText }`; its raw schema must produce `{ displayName, amountMinor }`. Accept ASCII digits with an optional decimal point and one or two decimal digits in the range 0 through 999999.99. Reject signs, spaces, empty text, exponent notation, a trailing point, and more than two decimal digits. `12.34` produces `1234`; `0.1` produces `10`; leading zeroes are valid. Load id `amount-7` with amount `1234` as text `12.34`, then submit numeric minor units once to the exact update id. Keep List route `loom-eval-amounts` and edit route `loom-eval-amounts-edit`; successful update returns to List through the normal view behavior. Do not cast the invalid declaration, add a Detail operation, or add permissions. Acceptance: B-01 exact parser rules; B-02 string draft and one numeric transform; B-03 exact record id and update payload; B-04 update destination is the List route; B-05 the deliberate declaration error is removed without a cast.
